summary: Senior platform engineer focused on reliable systems, clear operational ownership, secure delivery pipelines, and developer workflows that reduce friction across growing product teams.

Led incident reviews and converted findings into tested platform safeguards.

Documented operational playbooks and service ownership boundaries.
Improved test coverage for critical infrastructure changes.
Built service integrations for operational teams.
Added automated checks for customer-facing workflows.
Supported production releases and documented recovery procedures.
Worked with product partners to clarify system requirements.
